rules.official_actual: verified after direct official source parser and validation pass
rules.primary_issuer_quote: verified for that issuer's own quote after direct source parser and validation pass
rules.media_only: reported; may become corroborated with 2+ independent credible sources; cannot become official canonical without official source
rules.research_forecast: store as research evidence/forecast, never overwrite actual observations
rules.conflict: preserve both records with source/methodology and flag disputed; never average automatically

on_source_failure: retain prior good production data; write run error; do not publish empty replacement
